ui.times.title: My times
ui.times.intro: Say when you can train: how long and at what time. A day without a time is a rest day.
ui.times.unavailable_help: A trip, a party or a day you are ill.
ui.times.saved_rebuilt: Done. The plan is rebuilt from tomorrow.
ui.times.saved_pending: The change is saved. It is used when your coach sends a new plan.
ui.times.kept: The new plan from your coach has the times your coach has. Your own times are kept below: press Save to lay the plan on them.
ui.times.pending: You saved new times on {date}. They are used when your coach sends a new plan.
ui.times.failed: The plan could not be rebuilt. Your times are saved.
ui.calendar.button: Add the workouts to the calendar
ui.calendar.help: Downloads a calendar file with the workouts from today. Open it to add them to the phone's calendar.
ui.load.title: Your training plan
ui.load.intro: Your coach makes the plan in Tröskel and sends it as a link, a QR code or a file. Open the link on the phone and the plan lands here.
ui.load.intro_own: The app shows your training plan: what to do today and the rest of the week. Everything stays on the phone, and no account is needed.
ui.load.error.not_a_plan: That is not a plan from Tröskel.
ui.load.error.too_new: The plan was made in a newer version of Tröskel. Update the app.
ui.load.error.other_engine: The plan was made with another version of Tröskel. Update the app.
ui.load.error.broken: The plan could not be read. Ask your coach to send it again.
ui.load.own_intro: Answer a few questions about when you can train and what you train for, and the app works out a plan here on the phone. No test is needed.
ui.load.coach_intro: If your coach makes the plan in Tröskel, you get it as a link, a QR code or a file. Open the link on the phone and the plan lands here. A copy you saved reads in the same way.
ui.request.title: Make a plan yourself
ui.request.intro: The same questions the coach answers in Tröskel. The plan is worked out here on the phone and never leaves it.
ui.request.no_test: Without a test the workouts are in zones and by effort, without heart rate and pace. If you know your max HR, thresholds, FTP or CSS pace, fill them in under Your values.
ui.request.tests_kept: The tests of your current plan come along, so the workouts keep the same heart rate and pace.
ui.request.recent_help: How much you have trained a week in the last few weeks. The plan starts close to it and builds up calmly. Empty: the app goes by the level.
ui.request.days_help: How long you can train and when in the day. A day without a time is a rest day.
ui.request.name: Your name (optional)
ui.request.name_help: The name is only in the plan, so that a coach sees it is yours if you send it to Tröskel.
ui.request.replace_confirm: The new plan replaces the one you have now. What you have ticked off stays. Continue?
ui.request.err.clock: {day}: the clock time cannot be read.
ui.request.err.start: Give the day the plan starts.
ui.request.err.weeks: Give the number of weeks, at most {hi}.
ui.request.err.failed: No plan could be made from the answers.
ui.qr.title: Point the camera at the QR code
ui.qr.no_camera: The camera could not start. Open the link or the file instead.
ui.demo.banner: This is an example, not your plan.
ui.about.title: About
ui.copy.title: A copy of the plan
ui.copy.what: The plan is only on this phone. Save a copy now and then, so that you can read the plan in again if the storage is emptied or on a new phone: with your changes, your values and times, what you ticked off and the sessions outside the plan.
ui.copy.state.tab: The app is open in the browser, where the storage may be emptied: Safari does so after seven days without a visit. Add the app to the home screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), and save a copy.
ui.copy.state.home: The browser has not promised to keep the app's storage, and may empty it when the phone runs short of space. Save a copy now and then.
ui.copy.state.kept: The browser has promised to keep the app's storage. A copy is needed when you change phones.
ui.copy.state.native: The app keeps its data in the phone's own storage. A copy is needed when you change phones or reinstall the app.
ui.copy.copy: Copy the copy as a link
ui.copy.saved: The copy is saved. Keep it where you will find it, such as iCloud Drive, Google Drive or an email to yourself.
ui.copy.copied: The link is copied. Paste it in an email or a note to yourself.
ui.copy.back: A copy reads in with Open a file or Paste a link when the app is empty, or under Receive a new plan.
ui.copy.replace_confirm: The copy is another plan than the one on the phone. Replace the plan with the copy?
ui.copy.remind: The phone may empty the app's storage.
ui.copy.remind_tab: In the browser the app's storage may be emptied, in Safari after seven days without a visit. Add the app to the home screen and save a copy.
ui.share.title: Send the plan to your coach
ui.share.what: Before a new test your coach can read your plan into Tröskel, so that the test gives your workouts new targets and your days, times and changes stay. What goes along: the plan as it is here, your times, what you have ticked off (also what the watch ticked off) and the sessions outside the plan.
ui.share.not: The nights (sleep, resting heart rate, HRV) and the watch's workouts stay here. The app sends nothing itself: you choose whom to give the file or the link to.
ui.share.consent: I want to share this with my coach
ui.share.saved: The file is saved. Send it to your coach.
ui.share.copied: The link is copied. Paste it in a message to your coach.
ui.share.not_saved: The file was not saved. Try again, or copy the link instead.
ui.share.copy_failed: The link could not be copied on this device. Save it as a file instead.
ui.about.privacy: The app sends no data anywhere. The plan, your times and what you have ticked off are kept on this device only. The link from your coach carries the plan itself, after the #, and that part is never sent to a server.
ui.about.delete: Delete all data on this device
ui.about.delete_confirm: Delete the plan, your times and what you have ticked off from this device?
ui.about.license: Tröskel is free software under the AGPL-3.0 licence. You may read, change and share the source code.
ui.about.plan: The plan was made on {date} with plan engine {v}.
ui.offline: The app works offline once it has been opened.
ui.log.label: How did it go?
ui.extra.later: A session outside the plan is added on the day or afterwards.
ui.extra.title: Sessions outside the plan
ui.extra.name: Name
ui.sum.title: The week in numbers
ui.season.title: The season
ui.season.label: The blocks week by week. Easy weeks are green, and the line is today.
ui.about.wall: For a tablet on the wall: the screen stays on, and the app goes back to today and this week after 3 minutes without a touch.
ui.about.wall_no_lock: This device cannot keep the screen on from the app. Set the screen timeout in the device's settings. The app still goes back to today.

ui.health.rhr: Resting heart rate {value} against your mean {mean}
ui.health.sleep: Only {value} hours of sleep last night
ui.hc.title: Health Connect
ui.hc.why: The app can read the workouts, the heart rate during them, the sleep, the resting heart rate and HRV from Health Connect, so that the workouts are ticked off by themselves and today's form shows under Today. The app only reads, writes nothing and sends nothing on. The data is kept on the device for 42 days and removed with Delete all data on this device. Garmin Connect does not write HRV to Health Connect.
ui.hc.on: The app reads Health Connect each time it opens. You change the permissions in Health Connect.
ui.hc.privacy: What the app does with the health data
ui.hc.unavailable: Health Connect is not on this device. On Android 13 and older it is installed from the Play Store.
ui.hc.denied: The app was not allowed to read Health Connect. You can give the permission in Health Connect.
ui.hc.failed: Health Connect could not be read just now.
ui.plan.own_values: Own values. A test in Tröskel replaces them.
ui.values.title: Your values
ui.values.intro: Fill in what you know, and the workouts get heart rate, pace or watt. Everything is optional. A test in Tröskel replaces your values in that sport.
ui.values.help: With both threshold heart rates the zones get your own borders, and the pace or watt at the thresholds comes with them. With only the max HR the zones are worked out from it.
ui.values.css_help: The pace you can hold for long, for instance from a 400 m and a 200 m swim.
ui.values.ski_help: Skis get heart rate and effort, no pace.
ui.values.borrowed: Borrows the zones of the test in {sport}.
ui.values.replace_confirm: Your own values replace the test from Tröskel in {sport} until the coach sends a new test. Continue?
ui.values.err.max_hr: {sport}: the max HR should lie between {lo} and {hi}.
ui.values.err.resting_hr: {sport}: the resting HR should lie between {lo} and {hi}.
ui.values.err.hr: {sport}: the threshold heart rate should lie between {lo} and {hi}.
ui.values.err.order: {sport}: the heart rates should rise from resting HR to LT1, LT2 and max HR.
ui.values.err.pace: {sport}: write the pace as min:sec per km, between {lo} and {hi}.
ui.values.err.load_order: {sport}: LT2 should be faster or heavier than LT1.
ui.values.err.watt: {sport}: the watt should lie between {lo} and {hi}.
ui.values.err.css: {sport}: write the CSS pace as min:sec per 100 m, between {lo} and {hi}.
ui.adjust.title: Change the workout
ui.adjust.nothing: The workout cannot be moved or shortened any more this week.
ui.adjust.help: The workout moves within its week. The change stays when you save new times or get a new test, and goes with the plan when you send it to your coach.
